QuestInfo.name: Extracurricular Studies
QuestInfo.0: After you reach Level 30, the headmaster strikes up a conversation with you.
QuestInfo.1: The Headmaster says you need to participate in a special #bafter-school training program#k. You should go to class and meet your teacher. Special Training, Class, and Teacher are the Resistance passwords! Go to the #bResistance Underground Base#k and meet with #b#p2151000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You were given a new mission in your capacity as a Resistance member. The task will not be an easy one, but it was specially assigned to you. You cannot refuse it, nor do you want to.

0.0: Salutations, #h0#! I see you've already reached Level 30. Splendid, splendid I say! You must be studying diligently and working hard to gain experience. I'm proud of you.
0.1: We are planning to hold a, erm... #bspecial after-school 'study session'#k for those who have reached Level 30. If you're not too busy, I'd like to invite you...

yes.0: Wonderful! The lesson will be taught by your homeroom teacher. Please #bproceed into the school#k. I think you will find this class both challenging and invigorating.

no.0: Ah, tired of studying already? But there's still so much for you to learn! Please, think it over. I feel that the subject matter in question is quite important.

1.0: Heya. It looks like you've been training. Good. A real warrior never stops training. Well, let's get to it! Show me what you've got.
1.1: Hmph. Not bad, kid. I've got a special assignment, just for you. It won't be easy. You're not gonna run off like a little scaredy-cat are you?

yes.0: Are you ready to hear about the mission?

npc.0: Oh, #h0#! Isn't it time for your #bspecial training#k session? Your #bhomeroom teacher#k is waiting for you in the #bclassroom#k. The same place you brought your #bSpecial Training Invitation#k last time, remember?
npc.1: #b(Special Training, Classroom, Homeroom Teacher... All of these are codewords used by the Resistance. This must be a Resistance mission! I should hurry over to the Underground Base.)#k
